		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = wm_rd_spk
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_seats_spk
				subtract = global_var:wm_seats_prev_spk
			}
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = wm_el_seats value = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats }
		save_scope_value_as = {
			name = wm_el_majority
			value = {
				value = global_var:wm_el_largest_seats
				multiply = 2
				subtract = 650
			}
		}
		title:e_united_kingdom.holder ?= { save_scope_as = wm_el_pm }
		global_var:wm_el_largest = { save_scope_as = wm_el_party }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = wm_el_gov_changed
				exists = global_var:wm_el_old_pm
				global_var:wm_el_old_pm = { is_alive = yes }
			}
			global_var:wm_el_old_pm = { save_scope_as = wm_el_old_pm }
		}
		# The player's own seat: held (with the share and majority), or lost at this election
		random_held_title = {
			limit = {
				tier = tier_county
				is_landless_type_title = no
				has_variable = wm_seat_share
			}
			save_scope_as = wm_my_seat
			save_scope_value_as = { name = wm_my_share value = { value = var:wm_seat_share divide = 10 } }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = wm_my_majority value = { value = var:wm_seat_majority divide = 10 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { exists = scope:wm_my_seat }
				exists = var:wm_lost_seat
			}
			var:wm_lost_seat = { save_scope_as = wm_my_lost_seat }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = wm_election_results.1.a
	}
}
